cases.name: blank-value-on-text
cases.description: value="" is a list with no options. The reference used to accept it and print a column of empty cells while the four ports refused the same file.

cases.name: whitespace-value-on-text
cases.description: A lone space is trimmed away before anything reads it, so it names no option either.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value=" "/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: blank-value-on-regex
cases.description: No pattern at all, as opposed to a pattern that matches nothing.

cases.name: blank-value-on-advanced-regex
cases.description: Same rule for the weighted flavour.

cases.name: blank-value-on-increment
cases.description: Number("") is 0 in the reference's host language, so a blank start silently counted 0 1 2 from an attribute that named nothing.

cases.name: blank-value-on-decrement
cases.description: The counter's other direction, held to the same rule.

cases.name: blank-value-on-number
cases.description: The worst of the six: four ports skipped the check when the text was blank, fell back to the default range and printed 4 2 8 for a config that had named no range at all.

cases.name: blank-value-on-template
cases.description: A blank address is no address, not an unknown one — TDC071 would offer to check the spelling of text nobody wrote.

cases.name: blank-value-on-symbol
cases.description: Already agreed five ways before the rule was written down; here so it stays that way.

cases.name: blank-value-on-pattern
cases.description: The other type that already agreed.

cases.name: a-comma-is-two-empty-options-and-stays-legal
cases.description: The line the refusals are drawn against. This names two options that both happen to be empty — there IS something to draw from — and all five accept it. Refusing value="" while accepting this is a claim about options, not about spelling.

cases.name: an-empty-group-is-a-pattern-and-stays-legal
cases.description: The same line on the regex side: a pattern that matches the empty string is a pattern, and all five run it.
